### It Is Sown in Dishonor, It Is Raised in Glory
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/it-is-sown-in-dishonor-it-is-raised-in-glory
Passage: 1 Corinthians 15:43
Points:
- Physical death is frequently accompanied by profound weakness, pain, and bodily indignity.
- Scripture confronts this reality honestly by describing the burial of the physical body as being sown in dishonor.
- Jesus endured bodily shame and agony in His crucifixion before rising in power.
- Christ's resurrection assures believers that what is laid in the grave in dishonor will be raised in glory.
- Christians can comfort and support one another in dying through the certain hope of bodily transformation.

### A Transformation Is Coming
Author: Jeff Schreve
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/fromhisheart/from-his-heart-week-of-march-2.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 15:42-44
Points:
- The decline and ailments of aging serve as daily reminders that our present physical bodies are perishable.
- Paul compares the resurrection body to an ordinary seed that yields a magnificent living plant.
- God's salvation redeems the entire person, culminating in the future transformation of the body.
- Believers will receive new spiritual bodies free from physical limitations, illness, pain, and mortality.
- Remembering this promised renewal gives Christians reason to praise God despite physical decline.

### Unraveling the Mystery
Author: R.C. Sproul
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/unraveling-mystery
Passage: 1 Corinthians 15:42-44
Points:
- The resurrection body maintains continuity with our earthly frame while also displaying dramatic discontinuity.
- While the specific details of glorified bodies remain partly mysterious, Christ's risen form gives key clues.
- Human life is intimately acquainted with weakness and decay, but the resurrection body will display power and glory.
- God will clothe His people in an immortality that they do not intrinsically possess.
- Reflecting on this eternal destiny should lead Christians into worship and thanksgiving to God.

### Questions about the Resurrected Body
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/questions-about-the-resurrected-body
Passage: 1 Corinthians 15:35-41
Points:
- Skeptical questions about how the dead rise often spring from a failure to trust God's power.
- The everyday agricultural process of a dying seed producing a living plant points to the reality of resurrection.
- The wide diversity of splendor among created bodies in heaven and on earth shows God can fashion new bodily forms.
- The resurrection body will have continuity with our earthly body while receiving a distinct, higher glory.
- Believers can rest in the omnipotence of God to accomplish all that He has promised to redeem.
